name: trait BytewiseEq <Rhs = Self> : PartialEq < Rhs > + Sized
rule: Implementors of `BytewiseEq<Rhs>` must ensure that `<Self as PartialEq<Rhs>>::eq` and `<Self as PartialEq<Rhs>>::ne` are equivalent to comparing the underlying bytes.
api: trait BytewiseEq <Rhs = Self> : PartialEq < Rhs > + Sized
